themes.title: Low-resource language models
themes.summary: Evaluation and development of efficient, culturally grounded language models for Tamil, Sinhala and other South Asian languages, including interest in small language models and data-efficient training.

themes.title: Tamil linguistic resources
themes.summary: Treebanks, morphological analysers, POS taggers, parsers, tokenisation frameworks, grammar engineering and annotation guidelines for modern and literary Tamil.

themes.title: Speech technology
themes.summary: Sri Lankan Tamil speech resources, ASR evaluation, dialect-aware phonetic transcription and expressive text-to-speech systems.

themes.title: OCR and text processing
themes.summary: Tamil OCR benchmarking, post-processing, Unicode normalization and text preprocessing for robust downstream NLP.

themes.title: South Asian NLP infrastructure
themes.summary: Cross-country collaborations, regional workshops and shared research infrastructure designed to strengthen language technology capacity in South Asia.

projects.title: Evaluating and Improving LLMs for Low-Resource Languages (LLM4LRL)
projects.summary: Research programme on data scarcity, dialectal variation and cultural awareness in LLMs for low-resource languages.

projects.title: Sri Lankan Tamil Language Model
projects.summary: Building and evaluating language models designed for Sri Lankan Tamil, with attention to linguistic and cultural grounding.

projects.title: CeyNews
projects.summary: A large trilingual Sri Lankan news corpus and models for news classification and headline generation across Sinhala, Tamil and English.

projects.title: TaLK-Corpus
projects.summary: Regionally diverse Sri Lankan Tamil speech benchmark covering speakers from 22 administrative districts.

projects.title: ILAKKANAM benchmark
projects.summary: Tamil-specific linguistic evaluation benchmark curated from Sri Lankan school-level Tamil examination questions.

projects.title: Tamil Universal Dependencies documentation
projects.summary: Developing practical Tamil UD annotation documentation, including tokenisation, clitics, auxiliaries and head-conversion principles.

projects.title: Thirukkuraḷ Treebank
projects.summary: Extending Universal Dependencies to Tamil poetics, including multiword tokenisation and ellipsis in the Thirukkuraḷ.

projects.title: Expressive Tamil TTS
projects.summary: PhD-linked work on expressive Tamil speech synthesis and dialect-aware speech technology.

projects.title: Tamil OCR improvement
projects.summary: Benchmarking Tamil OCR and developing post-processing techniques to improve recognition quality.

projects.title: DigSAL: Addressing the Digital Divide for South Asian Languages
projects.summary: DAAD-SDG partnership strengthening language-technology capacity and resources across partner institutions in Germany, Sri Lanka and Pakistan.

projects.title: Annotated Resources and Tools for Tamil
projects.summary: Treebanks, annotation guidelines, NLP tools and parser resources for Tamil, including collaboration with IIIT Hyderabad.

projects.title: Tamil Lexical-Functional Grammar
projects.summary: Lexical-Functional Grammar modelling and parser development for Tamil in collaboration with Miriam Butt and the University of Konstanz.

projects.title: Sinhala Dependency Treebank
projects.summary: Dependency treebank work for Sinhala developed with collaborators in Sri Lanka.
